/bin/zsh -lc "mkdir -p results && cat > analyze.py <<'PY'
\"\"\"Fit stress-strain data by material and write a figure and summary.\"\"\"
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
DATA = ROOT / \"measurements.csv\"
OUT = ROOT / \"results\"
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

df = pd.read_csv(DATA)
required = {\"specimen\", \"material\", \"strain\", \"stress_mpa\"}
if not required.issubset(df.columns):
    raise ValueError(f\"CSV must contain columns: {sorted(required)}\")

materials = list(dict.fromkeys(df[\"material\"]))
colors = {\"aluminum\": \"#4c78a8\", \"steel\": \"#e45756\", \"titanium\": \"#54a24b\"}
fits = {}
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, len(materials), figsize=(15, 4.8), sharey=True, constrained_layout=True)
if len(materials) == 1:
    axes = [axes]

for ax, material in zip(axes, materials):
    group = df[df.material == material]
    x = group.strain.to_numpy()
    y = group.stress_mpa.to_numpy()
    slope, intercept = np.polyfit(x, y, 1)
    yhat = slope * x + intercept
    ss_res = np.sum((y - yhat) ** 2)
    ss_tot = np.sum((y - y.mean()) ** 2)
    r2 = 1 - ss_res / ss_tot
    specimen_slopes = []
    for specimen, spec in group.groupby(\"specimen\", sort=False):
        sx = spec.strain.to_numpy()
        sy = spec.stress_mpa.to_numpy()
        spec_slope, _ = np.polyfit(sx, sy, 1)
